cards.name: Summer Day Camps for Youth Mountain Bikers
cards.description: Campers practice mountain bike skills on trails and skills features, with morning and afternoon rides, bike games, and off-bike activities. Riders must already be able to ride, brake, shift gears, and have some trail experience.

hours.text: Camp runs 9:30am-3:30pm each day. DropOff is from 9-9:30am and PickUp is from 3:30-4pm.
